couplets.en: I wept at how it ended.

lines: Yun to har shaam ummeedon mein guzar jaati thi
couplets.en: I used to pass each evening in hope.

lines: Kabhi taqdeer ka maatam, kabhi duniya ka gila
couplets.en: At times I mourned my fate, at times I blamed the world.

lines: Manzil-e-ishq mein har gaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: On the road of love, I wept at every step.
